correctness.rationale: Every possible order k≥4 not divisible by three contradicts the periodic adjacent equality/inequality pattern. Exact substitution reduction/lifting classifies all orders from witnessed bases 1 and 2. Ternary quotient factorization and c(3a)=0, c(3a+1)=1, c(3a+2)=1-c(a) yield the exact all-position tests. The discrepancy D(3m+r)=-D(m)+constant, with |constant|≤1/2, proves density c=1/2 with O(log N) error and hence the stated conditional densities. Boundaries t=0, q=0 and all r were included. The standalone checker passes 2,097,152 direct finite antisquare comparisons, but infinite correctness follows from the symbolic derivation, not enumeration.
